clusters.headline: South African white genocide does not exist, new ambassador to US tells BBC
clusters.summary: Roelf Meyer tells the BBC that being a white Afrikaner gives him legitimacy to challenge Trump's claim of a genocide.

clusters.headline: How Bulgaria become a global leader in battery storage and what this means for the country's grid and energy market?
clusters.summary: In under two years, Bulgaria has become one of the world's most battery-intensive energy markets. Can the surge last — and what will it mean for conventional power generators?

clusters.headline: Czech PM Andrej Babis reiterates importance of NATO for his country but rejects calls to increase defense spending
clusters.summary: The US and NATO want Czechia to spend more on defense. Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babis says Prague cannot afford faster increases, despite growing warnings about the threat from Russia.

clusters.headline: Iranian President Pezeshkian brought a diplomatic tone to New York for UNGA. What did his remarks signal?
clusters.summary: Iran's president used his trip to New York this week for the UN General Assembly to signal openness to talks over the nuclear dispute. However, the chances of a major breakthrough on the war remain low.

clusters.headline: A HRW report shows how South Korean women face systemic barriers to climbing the career ladder
clusters.summary: A new report shows how in South Korea, women on average earn less and have fewer employment opportunities throughout their lives.

clusters.headline: 'Lithuanian skies are NATO skies': DW speaks with Lithuanian premier Mindaugas Sinkevicius
clusters.summary: In a DW interview, Prime Minister Mindaugas Sinkevicius discussed threats to Lithuania from Russia and Belarus, NATO's need for stronger air defense and why military spending alone cannot ensure security.

clusters.headline: Nigeria: Nigeria, U.S. Sign Framework to Attract Investment Into $700bn Mineral Resources
clusters.summary: [Premium Times] The framework is expected to use the relationship between the Nigerian and US governments as a foundation for business-to-business transactions and investment across Nigeria's mineral value chain.

clusters.headline: After Xi-Trump summit, US-China rivalry remains frozen. Is this to Beijing's advantage?
clusters.summary: The US president showcased White House construction projects and hosted a lavish dinner with tech CEOs, but the summit made little progress on key issues such as trade tensions and AI regulation.
